invariant: ADR-0150 D2 (ruled): behavioural metadata is addressed by (namespace, name) while its identity is (package id, name), and several packages may share one namespace (ADR-0130 D1 artifact co-owners, ADR-0141 D5 dependency co-owners), so the address NAMESPACE/NAME names one item only if no two packages of the namespace hold it. This module is the ONE predicate for the twelve bucket 2/3 types phase 1's one-holder list does not cover (sharing_rule, queue, assignment_rule, hook, job, app, page, dashboard, report, book, analytics_cube, tool): SchemaRegistry.installPackage asks it right after the ADR-0130 D3 object check, ahead of every mutation and at every install, and os validate / os build ask it over an artifact's packages in the boot's install order, printing the same sentence. A packages[] stack's residual (ADR-0130 D4, registered under the stack's own id, never through installPackage) is one more holder of the stack's namespace: the manifest service asks the same predicate once every body has installed and before any residual item registers, a residual that registered is recorded so what registers after it is judged against it, and uninstalling its owner id frees its names (#31720). Every holder is named. ⛔ Never judge a package with no namespace, a shareable platform namespace (base, system, sys: the namespace gate's exemption), the environment catalog, or the same package again; never a type outside the twelve (a wider narrowing is the maintainer's); never package-scoped resolution (ADR-0150 child R); never let OS_METADATA_COLLISION=warn downgrade it; never a second copy of the predicate at either door.
